privacy.title: Privacy in HVL Interaktiv
privacy.intro: HVL Interaktiv is a service of Western Norway University of Applied Sciences (HVL) for interactive learning activities. HVL is responsible for the data. Here you can read what we store, why, for how long and who sees what.
privacy.learnersHeading: What we store about you as a student
privacy.learners1: We do not store your name, your e-mail address, your Feide ID or your national identity number.
privacy.learners2: You get a code instead of a name. The code is computed from your login with a secret key for each academic year, and on its own it does not say who you are.
privacy.learners3: We store the answers you have given so far in an activity, so you can continue where you left off.
privacy.learners4: We store short events from the activities, for example that you answered a question, how many points you got and how long you took.
privacy.why1: So you can continue where you left off, and so teachers can see what the student group finds hard and plan their teaching around it.
privacy.why2: When an activity is a graded assignment in Canvas, we send the points to Canvas. The points are formative and not exam evidence.
privacy.why3: HVL processes the data because teaching is a task carried out in the public interest (GDPR Article 6(1)(e)).
privacy.howLong1: Answers, events and your code are deleted 30 days after the academic year ends. The key for that academic year is destroyed too, so what remains cannot be linked to you.
privacy.howLong2: After that we keep only combined numbers for groups of at least 5 students.
privacy.howLong3: The service’s logs contain no personal data and are deleted after 30 days.
privacy.who1: Teachers see only combined results for groups of at least 5 students. A group of fewer than 5 is shown as “< 5”. No teacher can see the answers of an individual student.
privacy.who2: Your teachers see points from a graded assignment in the Canvas gradebook, as they see other assignments.
privacy.who3: Administrators at HVL see data only through a support action that is logged.
privacy.staff1: We store your name and e-mail address, so co-authors can find you, and which activities you own or co-author.
privacy.staff2: We remember which notices you have closed. Logins are logged without your IP address in plain text, and the log is deleted after 2 years.
privacy.safety1: The data is stored encrypted in Norway or the EEA.
privacy.safety2: The pages load no scripts, fonts or tracking from other websites. The exception is video from a video service HVL has approved, such as Panopto, when a teacher has added such a video.
privacy.rights1: You can ask for access to, correction of and deletion of data about you. Contact HVL’s data protection officer.

help.title: Help
help.intro: Here you find help with creating and using activities in HVL Interaktiv.
help.create1: Log in with Feide on the home page.
help.create3: Choose a content type, for example Multiple Choice or Interactive Video, and fill in the form.
help.create4: Choose “Save”. After the first save you go to the activity’s page, where you can play it and keep editing.
help.check1: Open the activity and choose the tab “Check and publish”.
help.check2: The check shows errors, warnings and hints about universal design and learning design. Choose “Go to the field” to fix something in the editor.
help.check3: Errors block publishing. Fix the error, or write why you publish anyway, for example that captions are being produced. The explanation holds for 14 days.
help.check4: Warnings and hints do not block publishing. Students see only published activities.
help.canvas1: Add the activity to your course in Canvas with the HVL Interaktiv tool. When you open it from Canvas, you see the tabs “Play” and, if you may edit it, “Edit”.
help.canvas2: Points in H5P are computed in the browser. Use them for formative assessment, not for exams or grades.
help.access1: The activities must work with a keyboard and a screen reader. Correct answers are marked “✓ Correct:” and incorrect answers “✗ Incorrect:”, not by colour alone.
help.more1: Ask HVL’s department for the development of learning and teaching (ALU) about learning design and universal design.
help.more2: Ask TeCopp about Canvas, and HVL’s IT service desk about logging in and technical problems.
